_instructions.hero: folder/filename (no extension) — which photo fills the full-screen hero
_instructions.featured: exactly 5 refs — the homepage mosaic, left-to-right. Photos: folder/filename (no extension). Videos: videos/filename.mp4 — autoplays silently in the grid.
_instructions.aboutPortrait: folder/filename — portrait shown in the About section

series._note: One entry per folder in photos/. Key must match the folder name exactly.

_fields.title: Display name shown in the UI
_fields.cover: Filename (no extension) used as the collection card thumbnail
_fields.cardHeight: Height in px of the card in the collections grid (try 180–320)

videos._note: One entry per video file in videos/. filename must match exactly including extension.

_fields.title: Display name shown under the video
_fields.duration: Duration string shown in the UI e.g. 2:34
